headline: Historic win: Bangladesh crush Australia by 9 wickets in Darwin
summary: The Tigers become the fastest Asian team to win a Test match in Australia, achieving the feat in just their third attempt.
details: Bangladesh secured their first-ever Test victory on Australian soil, defeating Australia by nine wickets in Darwin. After bowling the hosts out for 284, the Tigers needed only 57 runs to win and achieved the goal in the second session of Day 4.
The Tigers have now become the quickest Asian team to win a Test in Australia, doing so in their third Test match Down Under. This surpasses the records of Pakistan (7 Tests) and India (12 Tests).
This victory marks the second-biggest Test win for Bangladesh, their second-biggest by wickets, and only their second win over Australia in seven Tests, following their 2017 triumph in Mirpur.

Australia has not lost a home Test to an Asian team other than India since 1995, 31 years ago. This win also represents Bangladesh's second victory in SENA countries, after beating New Zealand in 2022.
Individual brilliance shone through as Hasan Mahmud took 9-111 in the match, the second-best figures by a Bangladesh pacer in Tests and the best by a Bangladesh bowler outside the country.

Tanzid Tamim scored a century and a duck in the same Test, becoming the sixth Bangladesh player to do so. Captain Najmul Hossain Shanto now holds the record for most Test wins as a Bangladesh captain with nine.
The historic match drew a massive crowd, with 18,352 fans attending the Darwin Test, the highest-ever attendance for a Test match at the venue.

headline: €75M deal: Barcelona reach deal to sign Rodri from Man City
summary: The 2024 Ballon d'Or winner and Spain captain moves to the Catalan club for approximately 87 million dollars.
details: Barcelona have reached an agreement with Manchester City to sign Spanish midfielder Rodri for a fee of around 75 million euros ($87 million), according to a club source.

The 30-year-old Spain captain and 2024 Ballon d'Or winner was a pivotal figure for Pep Guardiola's City side, winning 12 major trophies including four Premier League titles and the 2023 Champions League.
Barcelona pushed to secure the former Atletico Madrid star after he was linked with Real Madrid following Spain's World Cup victory in July.
The move comes as Barca's Dutch midfielder Frenkie de Jong is expected to miss several months due to injury, prompting the club to seek a high-profile replacement.
Rodri joins other new summer signings at Camp Nou, including Anthony Gordon, Karim Adeyemi, and Jesse Bisiwu.
The club is also expected to finalize a deal for Joao Cancelo in the coming days, following his loan spell from Al Hilal last season.

Barcelona pushed to secure the former Atletico Madrid star after he was linked with Real Madrid following Spain's World Cup victory in July.

The move comes as Barca's Dutch midfielder Frenkie de Jong is expected to miss several months due to injury, prompting the club to seek a high-profile replacement.

Rodri joins other new summer signings at Camp Nou, including Anthony Gordon, Karim Adeyemi, and Jesse Bisiwu.
